EN: For singing that famous battle hymn, the National Anthem.
ZH: 为了演唱那首著名的抗争之歌，国歌！

EN: This dress shines when you need a fast gun and a quick exit!
ZH: 这件婚纱闪闪发光，适合快速拔枪、快速逃离的场合！

EN: Advanced life support and sensors. Smells sort of minty.
ZH: 先进的生命支持系统和传感器，还有一点薄荷味。

EN: A favorite of Wasteland elitists and real estate developers.
ZH: 废土精英和房地产开发商的最爱。

EN: Best used when sleeping or... entertaining.
ZH: 最好在睡觉或者……娱乐时使用。

EN: Go to bed grinning and wake up smiling. Every. Single. Time.
ZH: 笑着睡着，笑着醒来。每！一！次！

EN: When the lights go out, your special skills shine.
ZH: 当灯灭了，你的特殊技能会发光。

EN: Because the Vault's Caps reserve doesn't count itself.
ZH: 因为避难所的瓶盖储备不会自我计算。

EN: Some light work wear for a squire on the go.
ZH: 轻便工作服，扈从必备。

EN: The official garb of the Brotherhood of Steel.
ZH: 钢铁兄弟会的正式服装。

EN: Get away with pulling rank when you're dressed like a BoS officer.
ZH: 穿上它，就算摆军官架子也没人敢管你。

EN: Reserved for the best of the best... of the BoS.
ZH: 为钢铁兄弟会中的精英们保留的。

EN: Uniform of America's spectator sport. No matter which version you prefer.
ZH: 最受欢迎的体育运动的制服。不论你喜欢哪个版本。

EN: The protection of choice for Wasteland mercenaries.
ZH: 废土雇佣兵的选择。

EN: Favored by runaway Synths... and the Synths who hunt them.
ZH: 逃跑的合成人和那些追捕他们的合成人……的最爱。

EN: Offers the look and protection of a mercenary captain.
ZH: 能让你拥有雇佣兵队长的外形与防护。

EN: If there is a higher power out there, they just might listen to you.
ZH: 如果有更高的力量存在，他们可能会听你的。

EN: Perfect for any child at heart forced to endure the Wastes.
ZH: 对于所有童心未泯、却不得不忍受废土的人来说再完美不过。

EN: Now all you need is a Rocket '69 and a pompadour.
ZH: 你现在只需要《69号火箭》和大背头了。

EN: +50% resistence against the Burned Condition
ZH: +50%抵抗燃烧条件

EN: They'll never see you coming and never know you were there.
ZH: 他们永远都不会知道你什么时候来的，也不会知道你一直在那里。

EN: The clothes make the man, and that man has something to sell you.
ZH: 人靠衣装，而这位衣冠楚楚的先生有东西要卖给你。

EN: Why? Because you're a Tunnel Snake. And you RULE!
ZH: 为什么？因为你是隧道蛇，你统治一切！

EN: Stylish and surprisingly warm. Ideal for close-quarters combat and late-night parties.
ZH: 时尚而出人意料地保暖，非常适合近战和夜间活动。

EN: It may be spring, but keep that shirt tucked in. This isn't a zoo.
ZH: 也许现在还是春天，但请你将衣服扎进去，这里可不是动物园。

EN: Once worn by a hard-nosed colonel. Now you give the orders.
ZH: 曾由一位强硬的上校穿着。现在轮到你发号施令了。

EN: The preferred battlefield armor of pre-war grunts.
ZH: 战前步兵的首选战场装甲。

EN: They used to send in an army. Now they only need you.
ZH: 他们过去曾派军队过去。现在他们只需要你就行了。

EN: Worn by the toughest ground pounders in the toughest battles.
ZH: 在最艰难的战斗里被最强悍的步兵穿过。

EN: Is this outfit some kind of joke? Nope, but you are, if you wear it.
ZH: 这套衣服是在开玩笑吗？不过，如果你穿上它的话，你就是个玩笑。

EN: Designed to strike fear into the hearts of Synths who have left the Institute.
ZH: 专为令脱离学院的合成人闻风丧胆而设计。

EN: By the power of Atom, you look fabulous!
ZH: 原子的力量让你看起来棒极了！

EN: Gumshoe gear for any self-respecting Wasteland detective. Human or not.
ZH: 为任何有自尊的废土侦探准备的侦探行头——不管你是不是人类。

EN: The outfit of choice when heading to the Diner for a shake.
ZH: 当你想去餐厅要一杯奶昔时，这件衣服是你的首选。

EN: Friends, Romans, countrymen... lend me your snazzy new outfit.
ZH: 朋友，罗马人，同胞们……请借给我你们时髦的新衣服。

EN: A uniform worth climbing the Enclave military ladder for.
ZH: 一套值得你在英克雷军阶上一路攀爬以求获得的军官制服。

EN: Optimized by the Enclave to be as deadly and badass as possible.
ZH: 经过英克雷优化，极具杀伤力且霸气十足。

EN: The lowest expression of the best defensive technology.
ZH: 最先进防御技术的最低级体现。

EN: Protects against sledgehammers, and not just on the job site.
ZH: 保护你免受巨锤危害。不仅限于工作场所。

EN: For those times when you need to exude charismatic evil.
ZH: 当你需要散发出邪恶魅力时，请穿上它。

EN: It's almost as Old as Longfellow himself.
ZH: 几乎和老费朗罗本人的年纪一般大了。

EN: The preferred outfit of flying aces everywhere.
ZH: 飞行王牌们偏爱的装备。

EN: Negative, Vault Dweller. The pattern is full.
ZH: 不行，避难所居民。进场航线已经满了。

EN: You can be my wingman any time!
ZH: 你可以随时做我的僚机！

EN: A gambler's outfit of choice. Feeling lucky?
ZH: 一个赌徒的选择。感觉自己手气不错吗？

EN: The look of a gambler, the skills of a hustler. That's a good bet.
ZH: 赌徒的样子，骗子的技巧。不错的赌局。

EN: Perfect for cheating your way through a poker tournament.
ZH: 对于在扑克锦标赛上一路出老千来说是个完美选择。

EN: Don't be a square, daddy-o.
ZH: 别做个老古董啦，帅哥。

EN: Great for fixing a leaking valve, or refueling a Chryslus Corvega.
ZH: 对于修理漏水的阀门，或者给可伟佳加油来说再好不过了。

EN: Fix a crashed Vertibird? You can build one from scratch.
ZH: 修好一架坠毁的垂直起降机？你都能从头造一台了。

EN: Perfect for surviving the Wasteland. Or writing a book about it.
ZH: 适合在废土上生存。或者适合写一本如何在废土上生存的书。

EN: When you're important enough, you don't need to wear a helmet.
ZH: 当你足够重要，就不需要戴头盔了。

EN: The best protection against hazardous materials.
ZH: 保护你远离危险品的伤害。

EN: Life may be unforgiving, but you've become unstoppable.
ZH: 生活也许是无情的，但已经没有什么能够阻挡你了。

EN: If the Wastes can spit it out, you can take it.
ZH: 只要是废土吐得出来的，你就接得住。

EN: You literally defied Death. Wear his hide with pride.
ZH: 你真正藐视了“死亡”。请骄傲地穿上他的毛皮。

EN: Lined with Famine's rags. For some reason, it always feels loose.
ZH: 用饥荒的破布做衬里。不知为啥，总是感觉松松垮垮的。

EN: Made from Pestilence's exoskeleton and still a bit radioactive.
ZH: 由“瘟疫”的甲壳制成，仍然有一点放射性。

EN: War covered the inside with motivational stickers.
ZH: “战争”在里面贴满了励志贴纸。

EN: No target too elusive... no fee too big.
ZH: 只要报酬给得好，没有目标抓不了。

EN: Ideal for tracking and wasting muties.
ZH: 适合追踪并放倒变种人。

EN: That booty can't stay hidden forever...
ZH: 赃物不可能永远不被发现……

EN: The best in human comfort-casual. For humans!
ZH: 舒适休闲风格的最佳选择，专为人类设计！

EN: Because even Synths like to relax at home.
ZH: 因为即使是合成人也喜欢在家放松。

EN: For SERIOUS Synth chill time.
ZH: 为合成人正经的休闲时光而设计。

EN: Look like a Synth - skip the identity crisis.
ZH: 让你看起来像个合成人——省掉身份认同危机。

EN: With no motorcycle, you'll surely be mistaken for a hoodlum.
ZH: 要是没有摩托车的话，你肯定会被当成小流氓。

EN: Replica of Elvis' Jailhouse Rock outfit from before the Fall. Worn by the New Vegas gang, The Kings.
ZH: 末日前猫王《监狱摇滚》演出服的复制品，曾由新维加斯帮派“猫王帮”穿着。

EN: The baseball legend may be dead, but his legend lives on! You are... number 42!
ZH: 这位棒球界的传奇也许已经死了，但他的传说将永远流传！穿上它，你就是……42号！

EN: When you want to look the fittest of the survivors.
ZH: 当你想看起来像幸存者中最硬核的那个时。

EN: Wear the crown, rule the Wasteland! Or at least pretend to.
ZH: 戴上王冠，统治废土！或者至少假装是这样。

EN: In the Wasteland, some forms of protection never go out of style.
ZH: 在废土上，有些保护形式永远不会过时的。

EN: Favored by scientists and doctors.
ZH: 受到科学家和医生的青睐。

EN: Split the atom or invent warp travel - all before lunch.
ZH: 分裂原子，或者发明曲速航行——全都能赶在午饭前搞定。

EN: Now you can unlock the secrets of life itself!
ZH: 现在你可以开始解开生命的秘密！

EN: Scary armor for one of the scariest figures in one of the scariest armies in the Wasteland.
ZH: 令人胆寒的护甲，属于废土上最凶悍的军队里最凶悍的人物之一。

EN: Prove to everyone that in the future, print's not dead.
ZH: 向所有人证明：在未来，纸质印刷并没有消亡。

EN: Saving lives, breaking hearts.
ZH: 拯救生命，打击心灵。

EN: No one will know you've never actually bowled before.
ZH: 没有人会知道你从未打过保龄球。

EN: From Modoc to Megaton, when you wear this, you are the law.
ZH: 从摩多克城到兆吨镇，当你戴上这个，你就是法律。

EN: Lucy's personalized Vault 33 suit, complete with survival enhancing rucksack!
ZH: 露西的专属33号避难所制服，配有增强生存能力的背包！

EN: Wearing it really brings you back to pre-war naivety. You can almost hear the bombs falling...
ZH: 穿上它，将你带回战前那段朴实无华的岁月。几乎能听见炸弹落下的声音……

EN: Don't look for whoever is in this get up to clutch their pearls. Chances are they're already holding a rifle.
ZH: 别指望穿着这身行头的人会大惊小怪，十有八九他们手里已经端着步枪了。

EN: The red hue conceals blood, and the rank chevrons conceal crippling self-doubt.
ZH: 红色能掩盖血迹，军衔臂章则能掩盖严重的自我怀疑。

EN: Settlements need rulers, and you're elected.
ZH: 定居点需要统治者，你被选中了。

EN: The Wasteland is littered with old wrecks. Time to get to work.
ZH: 废土上堆满了各种残骸。是时候开始工作了。

EN: When leather just won't do. Can stop one bullet, or a hundred.
ZH: 当皮革没有用的时候。可以阻止一颗子弹，或一百颗。

EN: You... are... an iron person! Cue cool song, commence killing.
ZH: 你……是……钢铁人！一边唱酷炫的歌，一边展开杀戮。

EN: A little more welding, a lot more steel, and... voila!
ZH: 多一点焊接，多一点钢铁，然后……瞧！

EN: Standard issue for soldiers before the Great War.
ZH: 战前士兵的标准装备。

EN: The battlefield is under your control. Orders?
ZH: 战场在你的掌控之下。有何命令？

EN: Great for giving orders, or wading into the fight yourself.
ZH: 对于发布命令，或自己战斗来说都很棒。

EN: May have been a vault suit, once upon a time.
ZH: 或许很久很久以前，它曾是一件避难所制服。

EN: Simple combat armor with an added regal flare.
ZH: 简单而华丽的战斗装甲。

EN: Perfect for hanging out at an old, abandoned drive-in.
ZH: 最适合在废弃的老式汽车影院里消磨时光。

EN: Linen: the only suit to wear in the Mojave Desert, unless you want pit stains.
ZH: 亚麻布：莫哈维沙漠中唯一合适的正装，除非你不在乎汗渍。

EN: NCR power armor, salvaged and modified so anyone can use it.
ZH: 经过改造翻新的新加州共和国动力装甲，任何人都可以驾驭。

EN: Tough, functional uniform of the NCR's valiant defenders.
ZH: 新加州共和国英勇卫士的坚固、实用的制服。

EN: You are silence. You are shadow. You are... ninja!
ZH: 你是沉默。你是影子。你是……忍者！

EN: There is nothing like bandoliers and heavy leather to inspire politeness toward an old man.
ZH: 没有什么比弹药带和厚皮衣更能让人对一个老头心生敬意了。

EN: Said to predate the very first Vault, this outfit was once worn by a pioneer Overseer.
ZH: 据说早在第一座避难所建立之前就已存在，曾由一位先驱监督者穿戴。

EN: The most advanced protection created for a human, lab-grown or otherwise.
ZH: 为人类（无论是否实验室培育）打造的最先进防护装备。

EN: The most advanced protection created for a human, lab-grown or otherwise.
ZH: 为人类（无论是否实验室培育）打造的最先进防护装备。

EN: Lead the repossession of ancient and powerful technologies in style.
ZH: 以优雅姿态率队收复古代强大技术的遗产。

EN: Report the news? You ARE the news.
ZH: 报道新闻吗？你就是新闻。

EN: Greet the Wasteland with a smile in this playful number.
ZH: 穿着这个有趣的玩意儿，带着微笑和废土打招呼。

EN: Before Power Armor even really existed, this baby was born.
ZH: 在动力装甲真正存在之前，这个宝贝诞生了。

EN: An enhanced prototype that saw limited use pre-war.
ZH: 一个增强的原型，战前使用得不多。

EN: One of the most advanced armors created before the Great War.
ZH: 战前制造的最先进的装甲之一。

EN: Armor worthy of a Brotherhood of Steel Star Paladin. And you.
ZH: 一个值得钢铁兄弟会星骑士穿戴的装甲。你值得拥有。

EN: The guys who protected the President wore this. It's THAT good.
ZH: 总统的保镖们穿过这个。就是这么厉害。

EN: Advanced post-war Power Armor, for a post-apocalyptic world.
ZH: 高级战后动力装甲，适合这末日后的世界。

EN: The most advanced protection created by human hands. Enjoy.
ZH: 人类双手创造的最先进的护甲。请尽情感受。

EN: Deployed pre-war against Chinese tanks. That's right - tanks.
ZH: 战前被派去对抗中国坦克。你没听错——就是坦克。

EN: Lovingly maintained. Favored by neo knights and paladins.
ZH: 保存得很好。骑士们很喜欢这种。

EN: The pinnacle of powered pre-war protection.
ZH: 战前装甲的巅峰。

EN: Renowned protection, favored by the Brotherhood of Steel.
ZH: 有名的护甲。钢铁兄弟会很喜欢。

EN: Specially enhanced and vastly superior to most other armors.
ZH: 特别加强过。比很多其他装甲都先进。

EN: For those with honor, willing to help out at a minute's notice.
ZH: 献给有荣誉感的人——他们随时都愿意出手相助。

EN: A mite flashy for the actual range, but looks great on camera.
ZH: 在真正的荒野上有点太花哨了，但在镜头前看起来很棒。

EN: Snack cakes aren't the only fancy lads in town.
ZH: 俏男孩夹心蛋糕可不是镇上唯一的俏男孩。

EN: Sometimes, just sometimes, brain really is better than brawn.
ZH: 有时候，只是有时候，脑子真的比肌肉强。

EN: Designed to protect its wearer from radiation.
ZH: 被设计用来保护穿戴者免受辐射伤害。

EN: Ever want to give a Glowing One a hug? Now's your chance.
ZH: 是不是想过要给发光种一个拥抱呀？现在你的机会来了。

EN: Ever feel like swimming in a pool of radioactive waste?
ZH: 曾想过在一个满是辐射废料的池子里游泳吗？

EN: The standard gear of Wasteland ruffians.
ZH: 废土暴徒的标准服装。

EN: For the psycho in charge of all the other psychos.
ZH: 给那个管着其他疯子的疯子准备的。

EN: Only the Wastes' toughest Raiders get to wear these duds.
ZH: 只有废土上最强悍的掠夺者才能穿这些装备。

EN: Look, it's been a long time since the dry cleaners shut down.
ZH: 你看，干洗店早就关门大吉很多年了。

EN: Functional and flattering, for all your Wasteland needs.
ZH: 好用又好看。这就是在废土探索的全部需求。

EN: The best mercs make the most Caps... and wear the best clothes.
ZH: 最好的佣兵赚最多的瓶盖……还穿着最好的衣服。

EN: Handle anything the Wastes throw at you... in style.
ZH: 把废墟带给你的任何东西都处理得……有型。

EN: Sturdy protection you can wear with company pride!
ZH: 坚固的防护服，穿上它，为公司感到骄傲！

EN: Just wearing it inspires you to build an army of automatons.
ZH: 只需穿上它，就能激发你建造机器人军团的灵感。

EN: No need to hide behind a protectron when you can wear one.
ZH: 不需要躲在保护者机器人后面，你可以直接穿上它。
